Output Grain: One row per calculated Client royalty receipt displayed in the Tempo Client Financials screen for a given Statement Period, with Song-level royalties and as much Source and Sub Source detail as is available in Tempo.
Physical Upstream Sources: edw.tempo_song_stmnt_orig_sub_sub_summ (post-calculation summary fact); edw.tempo_orig_office; tempo_client (Client, Originating Office Client, Primary Client); tempo_client_type; tempo_company; tempo_company_group; tempo_contract; tempo_subcontract; tempo_song; tempo_source; tempo_source_country; tempo_income_type; tempo_income_type_group; tempo_rate_type; tempo_transaction_type.
Join Logic: The source summary is first aggregated across its receipt dimensions and seven monetary measures. LEFT JOINs then add current or governed descriptive context without intentionally removing receipts. Contract uses orig_office_id + contract_id; Song uses song_id + song_sequence_id; current Client, Contract and Song records require prior_version_ind = N. Subcontract is reduced to the latest updated current record. Each Source role is joined separately, and Source Country is reduced to one active row by preferring primary_ind = Y and otherwise the latest update_dt.
Filters / Row Selection: The source population is restricted to affiliate_income_ind = 'N'. This is mandatory because including both Y and N produces exactly double the expected numerical amounts relative to the Tempo Client Financials UI. Source Country lookups use active_ind = 'Y'. Current-version filters are applied within descriptive reference joins. No Accounting Period filter or field is used; reporting is driven by statement_period_dt.
Transformation Type: Post-calculation aggregation, deterministic reference enrichment, and operational UI presentation.
Transformation Summary: Tempo runs the Earnings Line Summarization process after royalty calculations complete. That process rolls detailed Earnings Lines into tempo_song_stmnt_orig_sub_sub_summ for faster UI access. client_financials_v further aggregates the approved non-affiliate population and enriches it with Client, office, contractual, Song, Source, income, rate and transaction descriptors so users can reproduce the Tempo Client Financials screen.
Business Rules: Amounts are in Client Originating Office currency and must not be combined across currencies without approved conversion. Statement Period represents the Client-facing statement and payment cycle, not the Accounting Period. Song detail and maximum available Source hierarchy detail are part of the business grain. Descriptive LEFT JOINs must not change financial totals. Client Local Income and Client Net Income remain semantically uncertified pending PV-SEL-031 and PV-SEL-032.
Measures / Outputs: Gross Client Income; Client Local Income; Client Net Income; Royalty Payable Amount; Calculated Withholding Tax; Client Office NPS; Foreign NPS, plus 45 identifying and descriptive attributes.
Downstream Dependencies: Tempo Client module Financial tab; Client Services and Royalty Operations analysis; Client statement and payment review; tax and NPS reconciliation; downstream BI or extracts requiring Tempo UI-equivalent Statement Period results.
Validation Status: Partially Validated — physical lineage and all transformation rules are validated; business definitions for Client Local Income and Client Net Income remain open.
